name: the-scanner
title: The Scanner
description: An isometric baggage scanner in SVG. Parcels ride in on the belt, slide out of sight behind the tunnel's solid near wall, and come out the far side while the scan light sweeps the mouth; one number drives the belt, both carriers and the light. It runs its own loop with a play/pause control, and once paused you can scrub the belt or drive it with the arrow keys.
